title: The Money Pit
about: A couple buy a mansion at a bargain price and watch it fall apart around them, one room at a time.
cue: Serve the turkey the moment it shoots out of the oven.
faces: Serve the turkey the moment it shoots out of the oven.
The front door frame comes away in Walter's hands
The bathtub goes through the floor
Montgomery Shrapp tears up the permits
Estelle shows the house by candlelight. Warm gruyere puffs, black pepper, thyme.
Short-line farm vegetables with green goddess
Anna was on the short line once. Baby vegetables, whipped ricotta, herb dressing.
Eat it now, before the ceiling comes in.
The turkey shoots out of the oven. Turkey breast, sourdough stuffing, gravy.
The staircase comes down under Walter. Fallen flourless chocolate cake, cream, raspberries.
The bathtub goes through the floor. Gin, lemon, sugar and soda, poured tall.
Toast the house before the door frame goes.
Serves everyone on the couch. Photos: TMDB.

    To StartCandlelit gruyere gougeresEstelle shows the house by candlelight. Warm gruyere puffs, black pepper, thyme.How to make it125ml water125ml milk100g butter, diced140g plain flour4 eggs120g gruyere, finely grated1 tsp Dijon mustard1 tsp thyme leavesBring the water, milk, butter and a pinch of salt to the boil, tip in the flour and beat over the heat until it forms a smooth ball.Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy.Beat in 100g of the gruyere, the mustard, thyme and plenty of pepper.Pipe walnut-sized balls onto lined trays and top with the rest of the cheese.Bake at 200°C until puffed, deep golden and crisp, and serve warm.Short-line farm vegetables with green goddessAnna was on the short line once. Baby vegetables, whipped ricotta, herb dressing.How to make it1 bunch baby carrots1 bunch radishes150g sugar snap peas1 bunch asparagus1 baby cos lettuce250g fresh ricotta1 lemon125g whole-egg mayonnaise125g sour cream1 cup mixed soft herbs (parsley, tarragon, chives)1 tbsp white wine vinegarBlanch the asparagus and snap peas for 1 minute, then plunge into iced water.Trim and halve the carrots and radishes, and split the cos into spears.Whip the ricotta with lemon zest, a pinch of salt and a splash of oil until smooth.Blitz the mayo, sour cream, herbs and vinegar until pale green.Spread the ricotta on a board, pile on the vegetables and serve the dressing alongside.Warm bread and salted butterEat it now, before the ceiling comes in.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsFlying herb-butter roast turkeyThe turkey shoots out of the oven. Turkey breast, sourdough stuffing, gravy.How to make it1.5kg turkey breast roast, skin on80g butter, softened2 tbsp sage and thyme, chopped1 lemon, zested300g sourdough, torn and dried1 brown onion, diced2 celery sticks, diced60g dried cranberries500ml chicken stock1 egg2 tbsp plain flourMash half the butter with the herbs and lemon zest and push it under the turkey skin. Season well.Roast at 180°C, basting twice, until the thickest part reaches 70°C, then rest under foil.Meanwhile soften the onion and celery in the rest of the butter, toss with the bread, cranberries, egg and 200ml stock, and bake in a dish alongside the turkey for 40 minutes.Stir the flour into the pan juices over the heat, whisk in the rest of the stock and simmer to a gravy.Slice the turkey and serve with the stuffing and gravy.Something SweetCollapsing staircase chocolate cakeThe staircase comes down under Walter. Fallen flourless chocolate cake, cream, raspberries.How to make it250g dark chocolate, chopped150g butter5 eggs, separated180g caster sugar30g cocoa powder300ml thickened cream125g raspberries1 tbsp icing sugarMelt the chocolate and butter together and cool slightly.Beat the yolks with half the sugar until pale, then stir in the chocolate and the cocoa.Whisk the whites to soft peaks, whisk in the rest of the sugar, then fold into the chocolate.Bake in a lined 22cm springform at 170°C until risen and just set. It will crack and sink as it cools.Fill the crater with whipped cream, scatter raspberries and dust with icing sugar.To DrinkBathtub gin fizzThe bathtub goes through the floor. Gin, lemon, sugar and soda, poured tall.How to make it180ml gin120ml lemon juice60g caster sugar60ml hot water500ml soda water1 lemon, sliced1 tray iceDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.Shake the gin, lemon juice and syrup hard with ice.Strain into 4 tall glasses of ice, top with soda and add a lemon slice.Champagne for the new ownersToast the house before the door frame goes.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
